title: Velvet Cloud
description: A softly lit volume of smoky plum and copper folds through darkness, stirred by sustained sound.

uniforms.name: speed
uniforms.label: Speed
uniforms.description: Slow ambient drift. Audio response continues at zero.

uniforms.name: sensitivity
uniforms.label: Audio influence
uniforms.description: How strongly light and shapes follow the music, with a smooth fade between accents; zero disables it.

uniforms.name: audioLight
uniforms.label: Audio light
uniforms.description: How strongly sound changes the lighting; zero keeps light steady.

uniforms.name: audioShape
uniforms.label: Audio deformation
uniforms.description: How strongly sound moves and reshapes the composition; zero keeps ambient motion only.

uniforms.name: shapeDetail
uniforms.label: Cloud folds
uniforms.description: Adjust the structure independently of audio influence.

uniforms.name: scale
uniforms.label: Scale
uniforms.description: Size of the composition; lower values bring it closer.

uniforms.name: background
uniforms.label: Background
uniforms.description: The quiet space behind the composition.
